checks.reason: This selection checks only the declared-compiler library target. All-target/all-feature compilation, Rust tests, Clippy, moving toolchains, fuzz and performance workloads require their own exact-source results; library-check success does not qualify them.

Linux container/direct checks do not qualify native macOS, Windows, Apple Silicon/ARM64, APFS or removable-volume behavior. Real media-tool/model availability, versions and supported processing profiles retain their owner qualification gates; no models or private media are selected.

The local act fixture uses checkout working-tree-copy emulation and executes the same bounded budget Python commands as the source gate. Remote Action bootstrap, hosted contexts/permissions, OIDC, artifact/cache/service backends, environments and cancellation/concurrency semantics are not established by this fixture.

Release/deployment/signing/attestation, live evidence admission, package publication and native installer/Snap/store qualification remain outside this local validation selection. No publishing workflow or credential is selected.

Rust 1.89 and the patched bundled SQLite graph are source selections. This library check does not execute cargo-deny advisories/bans/licenses/sources, qualify native database behavior or grant transaction/PNG replacement authority under #93/#95/#111.
